relations.description: Transition from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 when Voice Domain Preference changes to IMS PS voice only and SMS over IP is preferred with IMS registered.
Voice Domain Preference change to IMS PS voice only guards the transition from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1.
SMS configuration change to prefer SMS over IP networks guards the transition from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1.
IMS registered condition guards the transition from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1.
CS domain not available condition establishes transition to PS mode 1 from CS/PS mode 1.
UE's usage setting change establishes self-transition within CS/PS mode 1.
